1.consolidated_definition: Se dice del gallo que tiene plumas en las patas. Es considerado inferior. Lo equiparan al marrueco o al manilo. En las jugadas, las apuestas van en su contra. La variante de uso general es calsao.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This term is used to describe a rooster with feathers on its legs. It is considered inferior and is often equated with the "marrueco" or "manilo". In games of chance, bets are typically placed against it. The more commonly used variant is "calsao".
